title: A card number in the prompt never reaches the model
goal: Payment card numbers must not be sent to a model while {{castApp}} is {{castTask}}: that is {{castOwner}}'s rule.
obstacle: A user types a card number into the prompt. Once it is in a model request it is already outside the company's hands.
control: The inspector reports sensitive data and the enforcing key blocks the call. The number is masked everywhere the lab shows the prompt, and the model is not called.
